# Overview

This R Markdown document provides the iCAMP workflow used to analyze
community assembly in BZ and EZ across two complete brewing cycles,
four brewing seasons, and the Park(Workshop) production backgrounds.

## Main result levels

The workflow produces:

- overall BZ/EZ assembly-process profiles;
- Season × SampleType context summaries;
- BrewingCycle × Season × SampleType cross-cycle reproducibility summaries;
- Context-level results, where
  `Context_SampleType = BrewingCycle × Season × Park × SampleType`;
- bin-level `Wtuvk`, `Ptk`, `BPtk`, `BRPtk`, and `Binwt` results;
- ASV-to-bin membership and a representative-bin phylogenetic tree.

The five mutually exclusive iCAMP processes are standardized as `HeS`, `HoS`,
`DL`, `HD`, and `DR_Others`. `DR_Others` denotes drift plus other
weak/undominated processes and should not be interpreted as pure drift.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = TRUE,
  warning = TRUE,
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

```{r initialize}
rm(list = ls())
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

## 0. User parameters

```{r parameters}
work_dir <- "."
asv_file  <- "ASV_table.tsv"
tree_file <- "tree.nwk"
meta_file <- "sample_metadata.xlsx"
tax_file  <- "taxonomy.tsv"  # optional

meta_sheet <- NULL

## Resolve paths once; knitr restores setwd() changes between chunks.
work_dir <- normalizePath(work_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
resolve_input_path <- function(path) {
  if (grepl("^(/|[A-Za-z]:|~|\\\\)", path)) return(path.expand(path))
  file.path(work_dir, path)
}
asv_file <- resolve_input_path(asv_file)
tree_file <- resolve_input_path(tree_file)
meta_file <- resolve_input_path(meta_file)
if (nzchar(tax_file)) tax_file <- resolve_input_path(tax_file)

out_dir <- file.path(work_dir, "BZ_EZ_iCAMP_output")
pd_dir  <- file.path(out_dir, "pd_big")

core_cycles <- c("Cycle1", "Cycle2")
target_sample_types <- c("BZ", "EZ")
season_levels <- c("Spring", "Summer", "Autumn", "Winter")

## Main iCAMP settings
rand_time <- 1000
nworker <- 4
memory_G <- 50
bin_size_limit <- 24
sig_index <- "SES.RC"
phylo_metric <- "bMPD"

## Output control: keep only results needed for interpretation/reproducibility.
## Turn save_diagnostics = TRUE only when troubleshooting.
## Bin-level analysis is ALWAYS run in the primary analysis.
save_diagnostics <- FALSE
save_png <- FALSE

## Optional sensitivity analysis for phylogenetic-bin size
run_bin_size_sensitivity <- FALSE
sensitivity_bin_sizes <- c(12, 24, 48)

## Optional sensitivity analysis for ASV prevalence.
## These thresholds are numbers of core samples in which an ASV is detected.
## The primary analysis uses NO prevalence filter beyond nonzero + tree matching.
run_prevalence_sensitivity <- FALSE
sensitivity_min_prevalence_n <- c(3, 9)

## Optional sensitivity analysis using independent BZ / EZ regional pools.
## These analyses start from the unfiltered core ASV matrix and rematch each
## sample type to the original phylogenetic tree independently.
run_stage_specific_pool_sensitivity <- FALSE

group_cols_to_boot <- c("SampleType")

context_nperm <- 9999
seed_main <- 20260721

## Coverage warnings are diagnostic only and do not filter ASVs.
tree_abundance_coverage_warning <- 0.80
per_sample_tree_coverage_warning <- 0.50
taxonomy_coverage_warning <- 0.95
```

## 1. Package checks

```{r package-checks}
required_packages <- c(
  "iCAMP",
  "ape",
  "vegan",
  "data.table",
  "dplyr",
  "tidyr",
  "ggplot2",
  "readr",
  "stringr",
  "patchwork",
  "readxl"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required R packages: ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
    ". Install them before running this supplementary script."
  )
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(iCAMP)
  library(ape)
  library(vegan)
  library(data.table)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(patchwork)
})

if (!exists("icamp.big", where = asNamespace("iCAMP"), inherits = FALSE)) {
  stop("The installed iCAMP package does not provide icamp.big().")
}

if (!requireNamespace("ggtree", quietly = TRUE)) {
  message("ggtree is not installed. Representative-bin trees will still be saved with ape.")
}
```

## 2. Output directories

Create the main output and phylogenetic-distance directories. The `pd_big` cache is rebuilt for a full run to avoid reuse across incompatible trees.

```{r output-directories}
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

## Rebuild the phylogenetic-distance backing files on every full run.
## icamp.big() otherwise reuses an existing pd.desc file even if the input tree changed.
if (dir.exists(pd_dir)) {
  unlink(pd_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
}
dir.create(pd_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

message("Working directory: ", work_dir)
message("Output directory: ", out_dir)
```

## 3. Helper functions

Define input readers, season normalization, strict count validation, process-name standardization, diagnostic writers, and bin-ID helpers.

```{r helper-functions}
read_auto <- function(path, sheet = NULL) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("File not found: ", path)
  ext <- tolower(tools::file_ext(path))

  if (ext == "csv") {
    return(
      as.data.frame(
        readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE, name_repair = "minimal"),
        check.names = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  if (ext %in% c("tsv", "txt")) {
    return(
      as.data.frame(
        readr::read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE, name_repair = "minimal"),
        check.names = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  if (ext %in% c("xlsx", "xls")) {
    if (!requireNamespace("readxl", quietly = TRUE)) {
      stop("Package 'readxl' is required for Excel metadata files.")
    }
    sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(path)
    if (is.null(sheet)) sheet <- sheets[1]
    return(
      as.data.frame(
        readxl::read_excel(path, sheet = sheet, .name_repair = "minimal"),
        check.names = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  stop("Unsupported file extension: ", ext)
}

normalize_season <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))

  key <- tolower(x)
  map <- c(
    "spring" = "Spring",
    "summer" = "Summer",
    "autumn" = "Autumn",
    "fall" = "Autumn",
    "winter" = "Winter"
  )

  hit <- key %in% names(map)
  x[hit] <- unname(map[key[hit]])
  x
}

## Fixed study-design mapping used only for strict QC of BrewingCycle labels.
derive_expected_brewing_cycle <- function(year, season) {
  y <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.numeric(as.character(year))))
  s <- normalize_season(season)
  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(y))

  out[y == 2023 & s %in% c("Summer", "Autumn", "Winter")] <- "Cycle1"
  out[y == 2024 & s == "Spring"] <- "Cycle1"
  out[y == 2024 & s %in% c("Summer", "Autumn", "Winter")] <- "Cycle2"
  out[y == 2025 & s == "Spring"] <- "Cycle2"

  out
}

as_numeric_matrix_strict <- function(x, object_name = "ASV count table") {
  raw <- as.matrix(x)

  suppressWarnings(
    num <- matrix(
      as.numeric(raw),
      nrow = nrow(raw),
      ncol = ncol(raw),
      dimnames = dimnames(raw)
    )
  )

  raw_chr <- trimws(as.character(raw))
  bad <- is.na(as.vector(num)) &
    !is.na(as.vector(raw)) &
    nzchar(raw_chr) &
    !toupper(raw_chr) %in% c("NA", "NAN")

  if (any(bad)) {
    bad_values <- unique(raw_chr[bad])
    stop(
      object_name,
      " contains non-numeric entries, for example: ",
      paste(head(bad_values, 10), collapse = ", "),
      ". The ASV table must contain raw counts only."
    )
  }

  if (any(!is.finite(num))) {
    stop(object_name, " contains NA/NaN/Inf values.")
  }

  if (any(num < 0)) {
    stop(object_name, " contains negative values.")
  }

  if (any(abs(num - round(num)) > 1e-8)) {
    stop(
      object_name,
      " contains non-integer values. iCAMP should be run on the raw ASV count matrix."
    )
  }

  num
}

safe_write_csv <- function(x, file, row_names = TRUE) {
  if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(
    write.csv(as.data.frame(x), file, row.names = row_names),
    error = function(e) {
      stop("Unable to save required output: ", file, "; reason: ", conditionMessage(e))
    }
  )
}

write_diagnostic_csv <- function(x, file, row_names = FALSE) {
  if (isTRUE(save_diagnostics)) {
    write.csv(as.data.frame(x), file, row.names = row_names)
  }
}

process_order <- c("HeS", "HoS", "DL", "HD", "DR_Others")

clean_process_name <- function(x) {
  raw <- trimws(as.character(x))
  key <- gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "", tolower(raw))
  out <- raw

  out[key %in% c("heterogeneousselection", "hes")] <- "HeS"
  out[key %in% c("homogeneousselection", "hos")] <- "HoS"
  out[key %in% c("dispersallimitation", "dl")] <- "DL"
  out[key %in% c("homogenizingdispersal", "hd")] <- "HD"
  out[key %in% c(
    "driftandothers", "driftothers", "drift",
    "undominated", "undominatedprocesses", "drothers", "dr"
  )] <- "DR_Others"

  out
}

detect_process_cols <- function(df) {
  cn <- colnames(df)
  cn[clean_process_name(cn) %in% process_order]
}

## Use one bin-ID convention throughout custom outputs and representative trees.
## iCAMP BPtk/BRPtk/Ptk/Binwt use column names such as bin1, bin2, ...
standardize_bin_id <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x <- sub("^bin", "", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  paste0("bin", x)
}

## ------------------------------------------------------------
```

## 4. Metadata and design QC

```{r metadata-design-qc}
meta <- read_auto(meta_file, meta_sheet)

required_meta_cols <- c(
  "SampleID", "Season", "SampleType", "Year", "Park",
  "WorkshopAge", "Replicate", "BrewingCycle", "BrewingGroupID"
)

missing_meta_cols <- setdiff(required_meta_cols, colnames(meta))
if (length(missing_meta_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Metadata is missing required columns: ",
    paste(missing_meta_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    SampleID = as.character(SampleID),
    Season = normalize_season(Season),
    SampleType = toupper(trimws(as.character(SampleType))),
    Year = as.character(Year),
    Park = as.character(Park),
    WorkshopAge = as.numeric(WorkshopAge),
    Replicate = as.character(Replicate),
    BrewingCycle = as.character(BrewingCycle),
    BrewingGroupID = as.character(BrewingGroupID)
  )

if (anyDuplicated(meta$SampleID)) {
  stop("Metadata contains duplicated SampleID values.")
}

expected_bgid <- paste(meta$BrewingCycle, meta$Season, meta$Park, sep = "_")
bad_bgid <- meta$BrewingGroupID != expected_bgid

if (any(bad_bgid, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  write.csv(
    meta[bad_bgid, ],
    file.path(out_dir, "ERROR_BrewingGroupID_mismatch.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  stop("BrewingGroupID is inconsistent with BrewingCycle + Season + Park.")
}

expected_cycle <- derive_expected_brewing_cycle(meta$Year, meta$Season)
target_stage_row <- meta$SampleType %in% target_sample_types

bad_cycle <- target_stage_row & (
  (!is.na(expected_cycle) & (is.na(meta$BrewingCycle) | meta$BrewingCycle != expected_cycle)) |
  (is.na(expected_cycle) & meta$BrewingCycle %in% core_cycles)
)

cycle_error_file <- file.path(out_dir, "ERROR_BrewingCycle_design_mismatch.csv")
if (file.exists(cycle_error_file)) unlink(cycle_error_file)

if (any(bad_cycle, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  cycle_bad_df <- meta[bad_cycle, , drop = FALSE]
  cycle_bad_df$ExpectedBrewingCycle <- expected_cycle[bad_cycle]
  write.csv(cycle_bad_df, cycle_error_file, row.names = FALSE)
  stop(
    "BrewingCycle is inconsistent with the fixed Year × Season study design. ",
    "See ERROR_BrewingCycle_design_mismatch.csv."
  )
}

park_age_map <- meta %>%
  distinct(Park, WorkshopAge) %>%
  arrange(Park)

write_diagnostic_csv(
  park_age_map,
  file.path(out_dir, "QC_Park_WorkshopAge_mapping.csv")
)

if (any(table(park_age_map$Park) > 1) ||
    any(table(park_age_map$WorkshopAge) > 1)) {
  stop(
    "Park and WorkshopAge are not one-to-one, which is inconsistent with the assumed study design."
  )
}

write_diagnostic_csv(
  meta,
  file.path(out_dir, "metadata_raw_checked.csv")
)

message("Metadata rows before ASV matching: ", nrow(meta))

## ------------------------------------------------------------
```

## 5. Read and validate the raw ASV count table

```{r read-asv-table}
if (!file.exists(asv_file)) stop("ASV count file not found: ", asv_file)

asv_dt <- data.table::fread(
  asv_file,
  data.table = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

if (ncol(asv_dt) < 3) {
  stop("The ASV table has too few columns. Check the input file.")
}

first_ids <- as.character(asv_dt[[1]])

asv_numeric <- as_numeric_matrix_strict(
  asv_dt[, -1, drop = FALSE],
  object_name = "ASV count table"
)

rownames(asv_numeric) <- first_ids

if (anyDuplicated(rownames(asv_numeric))) {
  stop("The first column of the ASV table contains duplicated identifiers.")
}

if (anyDuplicated(colnames(asv_numeric))) {
  stop("The ASV table contains duplicated column identifiers.")
}

n_match_col <- length(intersect(colnames(asv_numeric), meta$SampleID))
n_match_row <- length(intersect(rownames(asv_numeric), meta$SampleID))

if (n_match_col == 0 && n_match_row == 0) {
  stop("No SampleID overlap was found between the ASV table and metadata.")
}

if (n_match_col >= n_match_row) {
  message("Detected ASV table orientation: rows = ASVs, columns = samples. Transposing.")
  comm_all <- t(asv_numeric)
} else {
  message("Detected ASV table orientation: rows = samples, columns = ASVs.")
  comm_all <- asv_numeric
}

if (anyDuplicated(rownames(comm_all))) {
  stop("The oriented ASV matrix contains duplicated sample identifiers.")
}

if (anyDuplicated(colnames(comm_all))) {
  stop("The oriented ASV matrix contains duplicated ASV identifiers.")
}

## ------------------------------------------------------------
##   Cycle1 + Cycle2
##   ×
##   BZ + EZ
```

## 6. Match samples and define the core iCAMP regional pool

```{r core-regional-pool}
core_expected_meta <- meta %>%
  filter(BrewingCycle %in% core_cycles, SampleType %in% target_sample_types)

missing_core_meta <- core_expected_meta %>%
  filter(!SampleID %in% rownames(comm_all))

core_match_summary <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Core_samples_expected_from_metadata",
    "Core_samples_present_in_ASV_table",
    "Core_samples_missing_from_ASV_table"
  ),
  Value = c(
    nrow(core_expected_meta),
    sum(core_expected_meta$SampleID %in% rownames(comm_all)),
    nrow(missing_core_meta)
  )
)
write.csv(
  core_match_summary,
  file.path(out_dir, "QC_core_sample_matching_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

missing_core_file <- file.path(out_dir, "QC_core_samples_missing_from_ASV_table.csv")
if (file.exists(missing_core_file)) unlink(missing_core_file)
if (nrow(missing_core_meta) > 0) {
  keep_qc_cols <- intersect(
    c("SampleID", "Year", "Season", "Park", "SampleType", "BrewingCycle", "Replicate"),
    colnames(missing_core_meta)
  )
  write.csv(
    missing_core_meta[, keep_qc_cols, drop = FALSE],
    missing_core_file,
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  warning(
    nrow(missing_core_meta),
    " core metadata sample(s) were not found in the ASV table. ",
    "The analysis will continue with matched samples; inspect QC_core_samples_missing_from_ASV_table.csv."
  )
}

## Extra ASV-table samples not represented in metadata are troubleshooting-only.
write_diagnostic_csv(
  data.frame(SampleID = setdiff(rownames(comm_all), meta$SampleID)),
  file.path(out_dir, "QC_samples_in_ASV_table_not_metadata.csv")
)

common_samples <- intersect(rownames(comm_all), meta$SampleID)

if (length(common_samples) < 3) {
  stop("Fewer than three samples are shared by the ASV table and metadata.")
}

comm_all <- comm_all[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]
meta <- meta[match(common_samples, meta$SampleID), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(all(rownames(comm_all) == meta$SampleID))

core_keep <- !is.na(meta$BrewingCycle) & !is.na(meta$SampleType) &
  meta$BrewingCycle %in% core_cycles &
  meta$SampleType %in% target_sample_types

write_diagnostic_csv(
  meta[!core_keep, , drop = FALSE],
  file.path(out_dir, "QC_samples_excluded_from_core_iCAMP_pool.csv")
)

meta <- meta[core_keep, , drop = FALSE]
comm_core_raw <- comm_all[meta$SampleID, , drop = FALSE]

## Invariant for this public BZ/EZ-only workflow.
if (!all(as.character(meta$SampleType) %in% target_sample_types)) {
  stop("Non-target SampleType values remain after core-sample filtering.")
}

## Core design fields must be complete before downstream grouping/inference.
core_design_cols <- c(
  "SampleID", "Season", "SampleType", "Park", "WorkshopAge",
  "BrewingCycle", "BrewingGroupID"
)
if (anyNA(meta[, core_design_cols, drop = FALSE])) {
  stop("Core iCAMP metadata contains missing design values.")
}
if (any(!meta$Season %in% season_levels)) {
  stop("Core iCAMP metadata contains unrecognized Season values.")
}

## Remove only ASVs that are absent from every core sample.
comm_core_raw <- comm_core_raw[
  ,
  colSums(comm_core_raw) > 0,
  drop = FALSE
]

zero_core_samples <- rownames(comm_core_raw)[rowSums(comm_core_raw) <= 0]
if (length(zero_core_samples) > 0) {
  write.csv(
    data.frame(SampleID = zero_core_samples),
    file.path(out_dir, "ERROR_zero_library_core_samples.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  stop(
    "At least one core sample has zero total ASV counts. See ERROR_zero_library_core_samples.csv."
  )
}

meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    Season = factor(Season, levels = season_levels),
    BrewingCycle = factor(BrewingCycle, levels = core_cycles),
    SampleType = factor(SampleType, levels = target_sample_types),
    Park = factor(Park),
    Season_SampleType = paste(Season, SampleType, sep = "_"),
    Cycle_SampleType = paste(BrewingCycle, SampleType, sep = "_"),
    Cycle_Season_SampleType = paste(BrewingCycle, Season, SampleType, sep = "_"),
    Season_SampleType_Park = paste(Season, SampleType, Park, sep = "_"),
    Cycle_Season_SampleType_Park = paste(BrewingCycle, Season, SampleType, Park, sep = "_"),
    Context_SampleType = paste(BrewingGroupID, SampleType, sep = "_")
  )

write_diagnostic_csv(
  meta,
  file.path(out_dir, "metadata_core_iCAMP.csv")
)

write_diagnostic_csv(
  meta %>%
    count(BrewingCycle, Season, Park, SampleType, name = "N"),
  file.path(out_dir, "QC_core_design_counts_Cycle_Season_Park_SampleType.csv")
)

write_diagnostic_csv(
  data.frame(
    SampleID = rownames(comm_core_raw),
    CoreLibrarySize = rowSums(comm_core_raw)
  ),
  file.path(out_dir, "QC_core_raw_library_sizes.csv")
)

message("Core iCAMP samples: ", nrow(comm_core_raw))
message("ASVs observed in at least one core sample before tree matching: ", ncol(comm_core_raw))

## ------------------------------------------------------------
##   intersect(colnames(comm_core_raw), tree_input$tip.label)
```

## 7. Match the core ASV community to the phylogenetic tree

```{r phylogenetic-tree-matching}
tree_input <- ape::read.tree(tree_file)

if (!inherits(tree_input, "phylo")) {
  stop("tree.nwk must contain exactly one phylogenetic tree.")
}
if (is.null(tree_input$tip.label)) {
  stop("The phylogenetic tree contains no tip labels.")
}
if (is.null(tree_input$edge.length) || any(!is.finite(tree_input$edge.length)) || any(tree_input$edge.length < 0)) {
  stop("The phylogenetic tree must contain finite, non-negative branch lengths for iCAMP.")
}

if (anyDuplicated(tree_input$tip.label)) {
  stop("The phylogenetic tree contains duplicated ASV tip labels.")
}

core_asvs <- colnames(comm_core_raw)
common_asvs <- core_asvs[core_asvs %in% tree_input$tip.label]

if (length(common_asvs) < 2L || nrow(comm_core_raw) < 3L) {
  stop("Tree-matched analysis requires at least two ASVs and three core samples.")
}
if (length(common_asvs) < 50) {
  warning(
    "Fewer than 50 ASVs are shared by the core community and phylogenetic tree. ",
    "Check ASV identifiers and tree construction before interpreting iCAMP."
  )
}

write_diagnostic_csv(
  data.frame(ASV = setdiff(core_asvs, tree_input$tip.label)),
  file.path(out_dir, "QC_ASVs_in_core_community_not_in_tree.csv")
)
write_diagnostic_csv(
  data.frame(ASV = setdiff(tree_input$tip.label, core_asvs)),
  file.path(out_dir, "QC_ASVs_in_tree_not_observed_in_core_community.csv")
)

comm <- comm_core_raw[, common_asvs, drop = FALSE]
tree <- ape::keep.tip(tree_input, common_asvs)

zero_tree_matched_samples <- rownames(comm)[rowSums(comm) <= 0]
if (length(zero_tree_matched_samples) > 0) {
  write.csv(
    data.frame(SampleID = zero_tree_matched_samples),
    file.path(out_dir, "ERROR_zero_tree_matched_library_samples.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  stop(
    "At least one core sample has zero counts after phylogenetic-tree matching. ",
    "The tree does not adequately represent all core samples."
  )
}

tree_matched_abundance <- sum(comm)
core_total_abundance <- sum(comm_core_raw)

per_sample_tree_coverage <- rowSums(comm) / rowSums(comm_core_raw)

coverage_summary <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Core_samples",
    "Core_ASVs_observed_before_tree_matching",
    "Phylogenetic_tree_tips",
    "Core_ASVs_matched_to_tree",
    "Fraction_of_core_ASVs_matched_to_tree",
    "Fraction_of_tree_tips_observed_in_core_community",
    "Tree_matched_abundance_fraction_of_core_community",
    "Per_sample_tree_coverage_min",
    "Per_sample_tree_coverage_median",
    "Per_sample_tree_coverage_mean"
  ),
  Value = c(
    nrow(comm_core_raw),
    ncol(comm_core_raw),
    length(tree_input$tip.label),
    length(common_asvs),
    length(common_asvs) / max(1, ncol(comm_core_raw)),
    length(common_asvs) / max(1, length(tree_input$tip.label)),
    tree_matched_abundance / max(1, core_total_abundance),
    min(per_sample_tree_coverage),
    median(per_sample_tree_coverage),
    mean(per_sample_tree_coverage)
  )
)

write.csv(
  coverage_summary,
  file.path(out_dir, "QC_tree_matching_coverage_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

per_sample_cov_df <- meta %>%
  select(SampleID, BrewingCycle, Season, Park, SampleType) %>%
  mutate(
    CoreLibrarySize = rowSums(comm_core_raw)[SampleID],
    TreeMatchedLibrarySize = rowSums(comm)[SampleID],
```

## 8. Optional taxonomy

```{r taxonomy}
taxonomy <- NULL

if (file.exists(tax_file)) {
  tax_dt <- data.table::fread(
    tax_file,
    data.table = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  if (ncol(tax_dt) < 2) {
    stop("taxonomy.tsv has too few columns.")
  }

  tax_df <- tax_dt[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  rownames(tax_df) <- as.character(tax_dt[[1]])

  if (anyDuplicated(rownames(tax_df))) {
    stop("The taxonomy table contains duplicated ASV identifiers.")
  }

  common_tax_for_tax <- colnames(comm)[colnames(comm) %in% rownames(tax_df)]
  missing_tax_asvs <- setdiff(colnames(comm), rownames(tax_df))
  taxonomy_coverage <- length(common_tax_for_tax) / max(1, ncol(comm))

  taxonomy_qc <- data.frame(
    Metric = c(
      "Final_iCAMP_ASVs",
      "Taxonomy_rows",
      "Taxonomy_ASVs_matched_to_final_iCAMP",
      "Final_iCAMP_ASVs_without_taxonomy",
      "Taxonomy_coverage_fraction"
    ),
    Value = c(
      ncol(comm),
      nrow(tax_df),
      length(common_tax_for_tax),
      length(missing_tax_asvs),
      taxonomy_coverage
    )
  )
  write.csv(
    taxonomy_qc,
    file.path(out_dir, "QC_taxonomy_matching_summary.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  missing_tax_file <- file.path(out_dir, "QC_iCAMP_ASVs_without_taxonomy.csv")
  if (file.exists(missing_tax_file)) unlink(missing_tax_file)
  if (length(missing_tax_asvs) > 0) {
    write.csv(
      data.frame(ASV = missing_tax_asvs),
      missing_tax_file,
      row.names = FALSE
    )
  }

  if (length(common_tax_for_tax) == 0) {
    warning(
      "taxonomy.tsv was found, but no taxonomy ASV IDs matched the final iCAMP ASVs. ",
      "Bin taxonomy annotation will be skipped."
    )
    taxonomy <- NULL
  } else {
    taxonomy <- tax_df[common_tax_for_tax, , drop = FALSE]
    write_diagnostic_csv(
      taxonomy,
      file.path(out_dir, "taxonomy_tree_matched_ASVs.csv"),
      row_names = TRUE
    )
    message(
      "Taxonomy matched to ", nrow(taxonomy), " / ", ncol(comm),
      " final ASVs (", round(taxonomy_coverage * 100, 2), "%)."
    )

    if (taxonomy_coverage < taxonomy_coverage_warning) {
      warning(
        "Taxonomy coverage is below ", taxonomy_coverage_warning * 100,
        "% of final iCAMP ASVs. Bin.TopClass remains optional annotation and should be interpreted cautiously."
      )
    }
  }
} else {
  message("taxonomy.tsv was not found. Taxonomy-dependent bin annotations will be skipped.")
}
```

## 12. Extract community-level process contribution matrix

Identify and standardize the community-level five-process contribution table returned by iCAMP.

```{r community-process-table}
## Identify the community-level result table returned by icamp.big().
find_icamp_process_table <- function(icamp_res) {
  ## With the current fixed settings (bMPD + SES.RC + within.bin + across.all),
  ## icamp.big() returns the community-level process table as bNRIiRCa.
  ## Prefer this explicit object; retain a small fallback for version compatibility.
  preferred <- "bNRIiRCa"
  candidate_names <- c(preferred, setdiff(names(icamp_res), preferred))
  
  for (nm in candidate_names) {
    if (!nm %in% names(icamp_res)) next
    x <- icamp_res[[nm]]
    if (!(is.matrix(x) || is.data.frame(x))) next
    
    df <- as.data.frame(x, check.names = FALSE)
    if (ncol(df) < 7) next
    
    proc_cols <- detect_process_cols(df)
    if (length(proc_cols) == length(process_order)) {
      message("Detected community-level iCAMP result object: ", nm)
      return(list(name = nm, table = df))
    }
  }
  
  stop(
    "Unable to identify the five-process community-level iCAMP table. ",
    "Expected columns equivalent to HeS, HoS, DL, HD and DR_Others."
  )
}

proc_obj <- find_icamp_process_table(icamp_res)
process_name <- proc_obj$name
process_table <- proc_obj$table

## Standardize the first two columns as sample-pair identifiers.

write_diagnostic_csv(

)
```

## 13. Bootstrap summaries by SampleType and brewing-season groupings

Generate bootstrap summaries for the overall BZ/EZ SampleType comparison.

```{r bootstrap-summaries}
run_icamp_boot_one_group <- function(group_col, process_table, meta, out_dir) {
  if (!group_col %in% colnames(meta)) {
    warning("Grouping column is absent from metadata: ", group_col)
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  treat <- data.frame(Group = meta[[group_col]])
  rownames(treat) <- meta$SampleID
  
  ## Groups with fewer than two samples cannot contribute within-group turnover pairs.
  tab <- table(treat$Group)
  keep_groups <- names(tab)[tab >= 2]
  treat <- treat[treat$Group %in% keep_groups, , drop = FALSE]
  
  if (length(unique(treat$Group)) < 1) {
    warning(group_col, " has no groups eligible for within-group analysis.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  bt <- icamp.boot(
    icamp.result = process_table,
    treat = treat,
    rand.time = rand_time,
    compare = TRUE,
    silent = FALSE,
    between.group = TRUE,
    ST.estimation = TRUE
  )
  
  if (!is.null(bt$summary)) {
    write.csv(
      bt$summary,
      file.path(out_dir, paste0("icamp_boot_summary_", group_col, ".csv")),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  if (!is.null(bt$compare) && isTRUE(save_diagnostics)) {
    write.csv(
      bt$compare,
      file.path(out_dir, paste0("icamp_boot_compare_", group_col, ".csv")),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  return(bt)
}

boot_list <- list()

for (gc in group_cols_to_boot) {
  message("Running bootstrap summary for grouping: ", gc)
  boot_list[[gc]] <- run_icamp_boot_one_group(gc, process_table, meta, out_dir)
}

if (isTRUE(save_diagnostics)) {
  saveRDS(boot_list, file.path(out_dir, "icamp_boot_all_groups.rds"))
}
```

## 14. Plot community-level assembly-process profiles

Create the community-level stacked assembly-process profile figure.

```{r community-process-plots}
plot_icamp_boot_bar <- function(boot_obj, group_col, out_dir) {
  if (is.null(boot_obj)) return(NULL)
  if (is.null(boot_obj$summary)) return(NULL)
  
  df <- as.data.frame(boot_obj$summary)
  
  if (!all(c("Group", "Process", "Observed") %in% colnames(df))) {
    warning("Bootstrap summary lacks Group / Process / Observed columns; plotting skipped for: ", group_col)
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  df$Process <- clean_process_name(df$Process)
  df <- df[df$Process %in% process_order, , drop = FALSE]
  if (identical(group_col, "SampleType")) {
    df <- df[df$Group %in% target_sample_types, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    warning("No standard five-process rows were found for plotting: ", group_col)
    return(NULL)
  }
  df$Process <- factor(df$Process, levels = process_order)
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Group, y = Observed, fill = Process)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.75) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    labs(
      x = group_col,
      y = "Relative importance",
      fill = "Process",
      title = paste("iCAMP community assembly processes by", group_col)
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0("Plot_iCAMP_bar_", group_col, ".pdf")),
    plot = p,
    width = 8,
    height = 5
  )
  
  if (isTRUE(save_png)) {
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0("Plot_iCAMP_bar_", group_col, ".png")),
      plot = p,
      width = 8,
      height = 5,
      dpi = 300
    )
  }
  
  return(p)
}

for (gc in names(boot_list)) {
  plot_icamp_boot_bar(boot_list[[gc]], gc, out_dir)
}
```

## 14B. Context-level assembly-process summaries and inference
```{r context-level-inference}
## Context_SampleType = BrewingCycle × Season × Park × SampleType

## Standardize sample-pair columns for compatibility across iCAMP versions.
process_table_std <- process_table
colnames(process_table_std)[1:2] <- c("Sample1", "Sample2")

## Standardize the five mutually exclusive ecological-process columns.
proc_cols0 <- detect_process_cols(process_table_std)
if (length(proc_cols0) != length(process_order)) {
  stop(
    "Expected five iCAMP process columns (HeS, HoS, DL, HD, DR_Others), but detected: ",
    paste(proc_cols0, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

mapped0 <- clean_process_name(proc_cols0)
if (anyDuplicated(mapped0) || !setequal(mapped0, process_order)) {
  stop("The detected iCAMP process columns could not be uniquely standardized to the five processes.")
}

names(process_table_std)[match(proc_cols0, names(process_table_std))] <- mapped0
process_cols_std <- process_order

process_sum <- rowSums(process_table_std[, process_cols_std, drop = FALSE])
if (any(!is.finite(process_sum))) {
  stop("Non-finite values were found in the five iCAMP process contributions.")
}
if (max(abs(process_sum - 1)) > 1e-5) {
  warning("The five iCAMP process contributions do not sum to 1 for at least one sample pair.")
}

if (length(process_cols_std) == length(process_order)) {
  msmall <- meta %>%
    select(SampleID, Year, BrewingCycle, Season, Park, WorkshopAge, SampleType, BrewingGroupID, Context_SampleType)

  m1 <- msmall; names(m1) <- paste0("S1_", names(m1))
  m2 <- msmall; names(m2) <- paste0("S2_", names(m2))

  pair_meta <- process_table_std %>%
    left_join(m1, by = c("Sample1" = "S1_SampleID")) %>%
    left_join(m2, by = c("Sample2" = "S2_SampleID"))

  context_pairs <- pair_meta %>%
    filter(!is.na(S1_Context_SampleType), S1_Context_SampleType == S2_Context_SampleType)

  write_diagnostic_csv(context_pairs, file.path(out_dir, "context_within_pair_process_contributions.csv"))

  if (nrow(context_pairs) > 0) {
    context_long <- context_pairs %>%
      select(
        Context_SampleType = S1_Context_SampleType,
        BrewingGroupID = S1_BrewingGroupID,
        BrewingCycle = S1_BrewingCycle,
        Season = S1_Season,
        Park = S1_Park,
        WorkshopAge = S1_WorkshopAge,
        SampleType = S1_SampleType,
        all_of(process_cols_std)
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = all_of(process_cols_std), names_to = "Process", values_to = "Contribution") %>%
      mutate(Contribution = as.numeric(Contribution), Process = clean_process_name(Process))

    context_summary <- context_long %>%
      group_by(Context_SampleType, BrewingGroupID, BrewingCycle, Season, Park, WorkshopAge, SampleType, Process) %>%
      summarise(
        N_pairs = n(),
        MeanContribution = mean(Contribution, na.rm = TRUE),
        SDContribution = sd(Contribution, na.rm = TRUE),
        MedianContribution = median(Contribution, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    write.csv(context_summary, file.path(out_dir, "context_level_assembly_processes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

    season_context_summary <- context_summary %>%
      group_by(Season, SampleType, Process) %>%
      summarise(
        N_context = n(),
        Mean = mean(MeanContribution, na.rm = TRUE),
        SD = sd(MeanContribution, na.rm = TRUE),
        Median = median(MeanContribution, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    write.csv(season_context_summary, file.path(out_dir, "context_level_Season_SampleType_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

    p_context <- season_context_summary %>%
      mutate(Season = factor(Season, levels = season_levels), Process = factor(Process, levels = process_order)) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = Season, y = Mean, fill = Process)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.75) +
      facet_wrap(~ SampleType, nrow = 1) +
      labs(
        x = "Brewing season", y = "Mean relative importance across contexts", fill = "Process",
        title = "Context-level assembly processes across brewing seasons",
        subtitle = "Context = BrewingCycle × Season × Park × SampleType"
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
      theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Plot_context_level_Season_by_SampleType.pdf"), p_context, width = 12, height = 5)
    if (isTRUE(save_png)) {
      ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Plot_context_level_Season_by_SampleType.png"), p_context, width = 12, height = 5, dpi = 300)
    }

    ## Permutation test for the Season effect: Contribution ~ BrewingCycle + Park + Season.
    ## Season labels are permuted within BrewingCycle × Park blocks.
    context_season_perm_test <- function(dat, nperm = 9999, seed = 1) {
      d <- dat[is.finite(dat$MeanContribution), , drop = FALSE]
      d$Season <- factor(d$Season, levels = season_levels)
      d$BrewingCycle <- factor(d$BrewingCycle, levels = core_cycles)
      d$Park <- factor(d$Park)
      if (nrow(d) < 8 || nlevels(droplevels(d$Season)) < 2) {
        return(data.frame(F = NA_real_, P = NA_real_, N_context = nrow(d)))
      }
      ## Drop constant nuisance factors when a context subset is incomplete.
      covariates <- c("BrewingCycle", "Park")
      covariates <- covariates[vapply(covariates, function(v) {
        length(unique(d[[v]])) > 1L
      }, logical(1))]
      model_formula <- reformulate(c(covariates, "Season"), response = "MeanContribution")
      fit <- lm(model_formula, data = d)
      if (df.residual(fit) <= 0L || fit$rank < ncol(model.matrix(fit))) {
        return(data.frame(F = NA_real_, P = NA_real_, N_context = nrow(d)))
      }
      aa <- anova(fit)
      if (!"Season" %in% rownames(aa)) return(data.frame(F = NA_real_, P = NA_real_, N_context = nrow(d)))
      obsF <- aa["Season", "F value"]
      if (!is.finite(obsF)) {
        return(data.frame(F = NA_real_, P = NA_real_, N_context = nrow(d)))
      }
      block <- interaction(d$BrewingCycle, d$Park, drop = TRUE)
      set.seed(seed)
      permF <- rep(NA_real_, nperm)
      for (b in seq_len(nperm)) {
        dp <- d
        dp$Season <- ave(as.character(dp$Season), block, FUN = function(x) sample(x, length(x), replace = FALSE))
        dp$Season <- factor(dp$Season, levels = season_levels)
        ap <- anova(lm(model_formula, data = dp))
        if ("Season" %in% rownames(ap)) permF[b] <- ap["Season", "F value"]
      }
      valid <- is.finite(permF)
      if (!any(valid)) {
        return(data.frame(F = as.numeric(obsF), P = NA_real_, N_context = nrow(d)))
      }
      data.frame(F = as.numeric(obsF), P = (sum(permF[valid] >= obsF) + 1) / (sum(valid) + 1), N_context = nrow(d))
    }

    test_list <- list(); kk <- 1
    for (stype in target_sample_types) {
      for (proc in process_order) {
        dd <- context_summary %>% filter(as.character(SampleType) == stype, Process == proc)
        if (nrow(dd) == 0) next
        tt <- context_season_perm_test(dd, nperm = context_nperm, seed = seed_main + 500 + kk)
        test_list[[kk]] <- cbind(data.frame(SampleType = stype, Process = proc), tt)
        kk <- kk + 1
      }
    }
    context_tests <- bind_rows(test_list) %>%
      group_by(SampleType) %>% mutate(P_BH = p.adjust(P, method = "BH")) %>% ungroup()
    write.csv(context_tests, file.path(out_dir, "context_level_Season_effect_permutation_tests.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

    ## Cross-cycle reproducibility of the five-process profile within Season × SampleType.
    cycle_profiles <- context_summary %>%
      group_by(BrewingCycle, Season, SampleType, Process) %>%
      summarise(N_context = n(), MeanContribution = mean(MeanContribution, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
    write_diagnostic_csv(cycle_profiles, file.path(out_dir, "cross_cycle_process_profiles.csv"))

    cycle_sim <- list(); kk <- 1
    for (stype in target_sample_types) {
      for (ss in season_levels) {
        dd <- cycle_profiles %>%
          filter(as.character(SampleType) == stype, as.character(Season) == ss) %>%
          select(BrewingCycle, Process, MeanContribution) %>%
          pivot_wider(names_from = BrewingCycle, values_from = MeanContribution)
        n_process <- if (all(core_cycles %in% names(dd))) {
          sum(complete.cases(dd[, core_cycles, drop = FALSE]))
        } else {
          0
        }
        if (n_process == length(process_order)) {
          rho <- suppressWarnings(cor(dd[[core_cycles[1]]], dd[[core_cycles[2]]], method = "spearman"))
          madiff <- mean(abs(dd[[core_cycles[1]]] - dd[[core_cycles[2]]]))
          cycle_sim[[kk]] <- data.frame(
            SampleType = stype,
            Season = ss,
            N_process = n_process,
            Spearman_ProcessProfile = rho,
            MeanAbsoluteProcessDifference = madiff
          )
          kk <- kk + 1
        }
      }
    }
    write.csv(bind_rows(cycle_sim), file.path(out_dir, "cross_cycle_reproducibility_by_Season_SampleType.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

    ## Descriptive consistency across the Park/WorkshopAge composite backgrounds.
    park_consistency <- context_summary %>%
      group_by(BrewingCycle, Season, SampleType, Process) %>%
      summarise(
        N_park_context = n_distinct(Park),
        MeanAcrossParks = mean(MeanContribution, na.rm = TRUE),
        SDAcrossParks = ifelse(N_park_context >= 2, sd(MeanContribution, na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),
        CVAcrossParks = ifelse(
          N_park_context >= 2 & abs(MeanAcrossParks) > 1e-12,
          SDAcrossParks / abs(MeanAcrossParks),
          NA_real_
        ),
        RangeAcrossParks = ifelse(
          N_park_context >= 2,
          diff(range(MeanContribution, na.rm = TRUE)),
          NA_real_
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(FullParkCoverage = N_park_context == nlevels(meta$Park))
    write.csv(park_consistency, file.path(out_dir, "cross_park_context_process_consistency.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  }
} else {
  stop("Context-level analysis requires all five standard iCAMP process columns.")
}
```

## 15. Bin-level analysis (always run)

Run `icamp.bins()` and retain the primary bin-level outputs required for downstream interpretation.

```{r bin-level-analysis}
message("Running icamp.bins() for bin-level results.")

## Keep only grouping schemes needed for interpretation.
## between.group = FALSE below retains within-group bin summaries (the quantities
## needed for Ptk/BPtk/BRPtk/Binwt) and avoids thousands of redundant pairwise
## comparisons among Season/Context groups. Bin-level analysis itself remains mandatory.
treat_multi <- data.frame(
  SampleType = as.character(meta$SampleType),
  Season_SampleType = meta$Season_SampleType,
  Cycle_Season_SampleType = meta$Cycle_Season_SampleType,
  Context_SampleType = meta$Context_SampleType,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

rownames(treat_multi) <- meta$SampleID

## Avoid obscure icamp.bins() failures from singleton within-group levels.
for (gc in colnames(treat_multi)) {
  tab_gc <- table(treat_multi[[gc]])
  if (any(tab_gc < 2)) {
    bad_gc <- names(tab_gc)[tab_gc < 2]
    stop(
      "Bin-level grouping '", gc, "' contains level(s) with fewer than 2 samples: ",
      paste(bad_gc, collapse = ", "),
      ". Check metadata/replication before running icamp.bins()."
    )
  }
}

## Try the complete icamp.big() object first and fall back to its detail element if required.

icamp_bin <- tryCatch({
  icamp.bins(
    icamp.detail = icamp_res,
    treat = treat_multi,
    clas = taxonomy,
    silent = FALSE,
    boot = TRUE,
    rand.time = rand_time,
    between.group = FALSE
  )
}, error = function(e1) {
  message("Direct use of icamp_res in icamp.bins() failed; trying icamp_res$detail.")
  message("Initial error: ", e1$message)
  
  if (!"detail" %in% names(icamp_res)) {
    stop("icamp_res has no detail element; icamp.bins() cannot continue.")
  }
  
  icamp.bins(
    icamp.detail = icamp_res$detail,
    treat = treat_multi,
    clas = taxonomy,
    silent = FALSE,
    boot = TRUE,
    rand.time = rand_time,
    between.group = FALSE
  )
})

saveRDS(icamp_bin, file.path(out_dir, "icamp_bin_level_results.rds"))

bin_objects_to_save <- c("Wtuvk", "Ptk", "BPtk", "BRPtk", "Binwt")

for (nm in bin_objects_to_save) {
  if (nm %in% names(icamp_bin)) {
    safe_write_csv(
      icamp_bin[[nm]],
      file.path(out_dir, paste0("iCAMP_bin_", nm, ".csv")),
      row_names = FALSE
    )
  }
}

if ("Bin.TopClass" %in% names(icamp_bin)) {
  btc <- as.data.frame(icamp_bin$Bin.TopClass, check.names = FALSE)
  if ("Bin" %in% colnames(btc)) btc$Bin <- standardize_bin_id(btc$Bin)
  safe_write_csv(btc, file.path(out_dir, "iCAMP_bin_Bin.TopClass.csv"), row_names = FALSE)
}
if (isTRUE(save_diagnostics) && "Class.Bin" %in% names(icamp_bin)) {
  class_bin_export <- as.data.frame(icamp_bin$Class.Bin)
  class_bin_export$ASV <- rownames(class_bin_export)
  safe_write_csv(class_bin_export, file.path(out_dir, "iCAMP_bin_Class.Bin.csv"), row_names = FALSE)
}

message("Primary bin-level results saved.")
```

## 16. Extract ASV-to-bin membership

```{r asv-bin-membership}
extract_asv_bin_membership <- function(icamp_res, icamp_bin, out_dir) {

  ## Preferred source: the primary iCAMP phylogenetic-binning object.
  if (
    "detail" %in% names(icamp_res) &&
    !is.null(icamp_res$detail$taxabin) &&
    !is.null(icamp_res$detail$taxabin$sp.bin)
  ) {
    cb <- as.data.frame(
      icamp_res$detail$taxabin$sp.bin,
      check.names = FALSE
    )

    cb$ASV <- rownames(cb)

    if ("bin.id.new" %in% colnames(cb)) {
      cb$Bin <- standardize_bin_id(cb$bin.id.new)
    } else if (ncol(cb) >= 4) {
      ## iCAMP taxa.binphy.big() defines the third sp.bin column as the final renewed bin ID.
      cb$Bin <- standardize_bin_id(cb[[3]])
    } else {
      stop("The primary taxabin$sp.bin object does not contain the final bin identifier.")
    }

    cb <- cb %>%
      select(ASV, everything())

    write.csv(
      cb,
      file.path(out_dir, "ASV_to_Bin_membership.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    return(cb)
  }

  ## Fallback source for version-dependent icamp.bins() outputs.
  if ("Class.Bin" %in% names(icamp_bin)) {
    cb <- as.data.frame(
      icamp_bin$Class.Bin,
      check.names = FALSE
    )

    cb$ASV <- rownames(cb)

    if ("Bin" %in% colnames(cb)) {
      cb$Bin <- standardize_bin_id(cb$Bin)
    } else {
      stop("Class.Bin was found, but its Bin column is absent.")
    }

    cb <- cb %>%
      select(ASV, everything())

    write.csv(
      cb,
      file.path(out_dir, "ASV_to_Bin_membership.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    return(cb)
  }

  warning(
    "ASV-to-bin membership could not be extracted automatically. ",
    "Inspect icamp_res$detail$taxabin and icamp_bin manually."
  )

  NULL
}

class_bin_df <- extract_asv_bin_membership(
  icamp_res = icamp_res,
  icamp_bin = icamp_bin,
  out_dir = out_dir
)
```

## 17. Major-bin contribution heatmap and bar plot

```{r major-bin-figure}
## Attempt to extract bin-by-process contributions from common iCAMP outputs.
## Column names differ among iCAMP versions; raw output tables are retained for manual inspection.

prepare_bin_contribution_long <- function(icamp_bin, source = "BPtk") {
  if (!source %in% names(icamp_bin)) return(NULL)

  df <- as.data.frame(icamp_bin[[source]], check.names = FALSE)
  required_cols <- c("GroupBasedOn", "Group", "Process")
  if (!all(required_cols %in% colnames(df))) {
    warning(source, " does not have the expected GroupBasedOn / Group / Process structure.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  ## In icamp.bins(), bins are columns (e.g. bin1, bin2, ...), while Process is a row field.
  bin_cols <- grep("^bin", colnames(df), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
  if (length(bin_cols) == 0) {
    warning("No bin columns were detected in ", source, ".")
    return(NULL)
  }

  df %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(bin_cols),
      names_to = "Bin",
      values_to = "Contribution"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Contribution = as.numeric(Contribution),
      Process = clean_process_name(Process),
      ContributionType = source
    ) %>%
    filter(Process %in% process_order, is.finite(Contribution))
}

## BPtk is used for ranking/plotting because it retains the absolute contribution
## of each bin to the community-level importance of each process.
bin_long <- prepare_bin_contribution_long(icamp_bin, source = "BPtk")

if (!is.null(bin_long) && nrow(bin_long) > 0) {
  write_diagnostic_csv(
    bin_long,
    file.path(out_dir, "iCAMP_bin_contribution_long_auto.csv"),
    row_names = FALSE
  )
  
  bin_plot_long <- bin_long %>%
    filter(GroupBasedOn == "SampleType", Group %in% target_sample_types)

  ## Rank bins by their summed absolute BPtk contribution across BZ/EZ and processes.
  top_bin_total <- bin_plot_long %>%
    group_by(Bin) %>%
    summarise(Total = sum(abs(Contribution), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(Total)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 25)
  
  top_bins <- top_bin_total$Bin
  
  heat_df <- bin_plot_long %>%
    filter(Bin %in% top_bins) %>%
    group_by(Bin, Process) %>%
    summarise(Contribution = mean(Contribution, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(top_bin_total, by = "Bin")
  
  heat_df$Bin <- factor(heat_df$Bin, levels = rev(top_bin_total$Bin))
  heat_df$Process <- factor(heat_df$Process, levels = process_order)
  
  p_heat <- ggplot(heat_df, aes(x = Process, y = Bin, fill = Contribution)) +
    geom_tile(color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#2C7FB8") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      fill = "Contribution",
      title = "Top phylogenetic bins contributing to assembly processes"
    ) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    )
  
  p_bar <- ggplot(top_bin_total, aes(x = Total, y = factor(Bin, levels = rev(Bin)))) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(Total, 3)), hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    labs(
      x = "Total contribution",
      y = NULL,
      title = "Total bin contribution"
    ) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    )
  
  p_bin_combined <- p_heat + p_bar + plot_layout(widths = c(2.2, 1))
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, "Plot_Top25_bin_process_heatmap_bar.pdf"),
    plot = p_bin_combined,
    width = 10,
    height = 8
  )
  
  if (isTRUE(save_png)) {
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(out_dir, "Plot_Top25_bin_process_heatmap_bar.png"),
      plot = p_bin_combined,
      width = 10,
      height = 8,
      dpi = 300
    )
  }
}
```

## 18. Representative phylogenetic tree of bins

```{r representative-bin-tree}

if (!is.null(class_bin_df) && all(c("ASV", "Bin") %in% colnames(class_bin_df))) {

  asv_abund <- colSums(comm)

  abund_df <- data.frame(
    ASV = names(asv_abund),
    TotalAbundance = as.numeric(asv_abund),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  bin_rep <- class_bin_df %>%
    select(ASV, Bin, everything()) %>%
    inner_join(abund_df, by = "ASV") %>%
    group_by(Bin) %>%
    slice_max(
      order_by = TotalAbundance,
      n = 1,
      with_ties = FALSE
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  write.csv(
    bin_rep,
    file.path(out_dir, "Representative_ASV_for_each_bin.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  rep_asvs <- bin_rep$ASV
  names(rep_asvs) <- as.character(bin_rep$Bin)

  rep_asvs <- rep_asvs[rep_asvs %in% tree$tip.label]

  if (length(rep_asvs) >= 3) {

    bin_tree <- ape::keep.tip(
      tree,
      as.character(rep_asvs)
    )

    bin_map <- data.frame(
      ASV = as.character(rep_asvs),
      Bin = names(rep_asvs),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    bin_tree$tip.label <- bin_map$Bin[
      match(bin_tree$tip.label, bin_map$ASV)
    ]

    ape::write.tree(
      bin_tree,
      file.path(out_dir, "Representative_bin_tree.nwk")
    )

    rep_tree_pdf <- file.path(out_dir, "Plot_Representative_bin_tree.pdf")

    if (requireNamespace("ggtree", quietly = TRUE)) {
      p_tree <- ggtree::ggtree(bin_tree) +
        ggtree::geom_tiplab(size = 3) +
        ggplot2::ggtitle("Representative phylogenetic tree of bins")

      ggsave(
        filename = rep_tree_pdf,
        plot = p_tree,
        width = 8,
        height = 10
      )
    } else {
      pdf(rep_tree_pdf, width = 8, height = 10)
      plot(bin_tree, cex = 0.7)
      title("Representative phylogenetic tree of bins")
      dev.off()
    }

  } else {
    warning(
      "Fewer than three representative ASVs were available for the ",
      "representative-bin tree; plotting skipped."
    )
  }
}
```

## 19. Optional prevalence-sensitivity analysis

```{r prevalence-sensitivity}
if (run_prevalence_sensitivity) {
  sens_prev_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "Sensitivity_prevalence")
  dir.create(sens_prev_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  sens_prev_summary <- list()
  sens_prev_counts <- list()

  for (mp in sensitivity_min_prevalence_n) {
    message("Running prevalence sensitivity: minimum detection count = ", mp)

    keep_asvs <- colnames(comm)[colSums(comm > 0) >= mp]

    if (length(keep_asvs) < 50) {
      warning(
        "Prevalence sensitivity minPrev", mp,
        " retained fewer than 50 ASVs. Interpret this sensitivity run cautiously."
      )
    }

    comm_p <- comm[, keep_asvs, drop = FALSE]
    if (length(keep_asvs) < 2L || any(rowSums(comm_p) <= 0)) {
      stop("Prevalence sensitivity minPrev", mp,
           " leaves fewer than two ASVs or a zero-library sample.")
    }
    tree_p <- ape::keep.tip(tree, keep_asvs)

    p_out <- file.path(sens_prev_dir, paste0("minPrev", mp))
    p_pd <- file.path(p_out, "pd_big")

    dir.create(p_out, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    if (dir.exists(p_pd)) unlink(p_pd, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
    dir.create(p_pd, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

    set.seed(seed_main + mp * 100)

    res_p <- icamp.big(
      comm = comm_p,
      tree = tree_p,
      pd.wd = p_pd,
      rand = rand_time,
      prefix = paste0("iCAMP_prevalence_minPrev", mp, "_bin", bin_size_limit),
      ds = 0.2,
      pd.cut = NA,
      sp.check = TRUE,
      phylo.rand.scale = "within.bin",
      taxa.rand.scale = "across.all",
      phylo.metric = phylo_metric,
      sig.index = sig_index,
      bin.size.limit = bin_size_limit,
      nworker = nworker,
      memory.G = memory_G,
      rtree.save = FALSE,
      detail.save = FALSE,
      qp.save = FALSE,
      detail.null = FALSE,
      ignore.zero = TRUE,
      output.wd = p_out,
      unit.sum = rowSums(comm_p),
      correct.special = TRUE,
      ses.cut = 1.96,
      rc.cut = 0.95,
      conf.cut = 0.975
    )

    saveRDS(
      res_p,
      file.path(p_out, paste0("icamp_res_minPrev", mp, ".rds"))
    )

    proc_p <- find_icamp_process_table(res_p)$table
    colnames(proc_p)[1:2] <- c("Sample1", "Sample2")

    bt_p <- run_icamp_boot_one_group(
      group_col = "Season_SampleType",
      process_table = proc_p,
      meta = meta,
      out_dir = p_out
    )

    if (!is.null(bt_p) && !is.null(bt_p$summary)) {
      tmp_summary <- as.data.frame(bt_p$summary)
      tmp_summary$SensitivityMinPrevalenceN <- mp
      sens_prev_summary[[paste0("minPrev", mp)]] <- tmp_summary
    }

    sens_prev_counts[[paste0("minPrev", mp)]] <- data.frame(
      SensitivityMinPrevalenceN = mp,
      NASVs = ncol(comm_p),
      FractionOfPrimaryASVs = ncol(comm_p) / ncol(comm)
    )
  }

  write.csv(
    bind_rows(sens_prev_counts),
    file.path(sens_prev_dir, "prevalence_sensitivity_ASV_counts.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  if (length(sens_prev_summary) > 0) {
    write.csv(
      bind_rows(sens_prev_summary),
      file.path(sens_prev_dir, "prevalence_sensitivity_Season_SampleType_summaries.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
  }

  saveRDS(
    sens_prev_summary,
    file.path(sens_prev_dir, "prevalence_sensitivity_summary_all.rds")
  )
}
```

## 21. Optional independent SampleType regional-pool sensitivity

Optional sensitivity analysis in which BZ and EZ are given independent regional pools. The primary analysis continues to use the shared BZ/EZ tree-matched regional pool.

```{r sampletype-pool-sensitivity}
if (run_stage_specific_pool_sensitivity) {
  sens_stage_dir <- file.path(
    out_dir,
    "Sensitivity_stage_specific_regional_pool"
  )

  dir.create(
    sens_stage_dir,
    showWarnings = FALSE,
    recursive = TRUE
  )

  stage_pool_counts <- list()

  for (stype in target_sample_types) {
    message("Running independent regional-pool sensitivity for SampleType: ", stype)

    ids <- meta$SampleID[as.character(meta$SampleType) == stype]
    comm_s0 <- comm_core_raw[ids, , drop = FALSE]

    ## Start from the unfiltered core ASV matrix for the selected SampleType.
    stage_observed_asvs <- colnames(comm_s0)[colSums(comm_s0) > 0]
    stage_tree_asvs <- stage_observed_asvs[
      stage_observed_asvs %in% tree$tip.label
    ]

    comm_s <- comm_s0[, stage_tree_asvs, drop = FALSE]
    if (length(stage_tree_asvs) < 2L || length(ids) < 3L) {
      stop("Insufficient samples or tree-matched ASVs for stage-specific pool: ", stype)
    }
    tree_s <- ape::keep.tip(tree, stage_tree_asvs)
    meta_s <- meta[match(rownames(comm_s), meta$SampleID), , drop = FALSE]

    if (any(rowSums(comm_s) <= 0)) {
      stop(
        "At least one ", stype,
        " sample has zero counts after stage-specific tree matching."
      )
    }

    stage_pool_counts[[stype]] <- data.frame(
      SampleType = stype,
      NSamples = nrow(comm_s),
      NASVsObservedBeforeTreeMatch = length(stage_observed_asvs),
      NASVsTreeMatched = ncol(comm_s),
      AbundanceCoverage = sum(comm_s) / sum(comm_s0)
    )

    s_out <- file.path(sens_stage_dir, stype)
    s_pd <- file.path(s_out, "pd_big")

    dir.create(s_out, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    if (dir.exists(s_pd)) unlink(s_pd, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
    dir.create(s_pd, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

    set.seed(seed_main + match(stype, target_sample_types) * 1000)

    res_s <- icamp.big(
      comm = comm_s,
      tree = tree_s,
      pd.wd = s_pd,
      rand = rand_time,
      prefix = paste0("iCAMP_stage_pool_", stype),
      ds = 0.2,
      pd.cut = NA,
      sp.check = TRUE,
      phylo.rand.scale = "within.bin",
      taxa.rand.scale = "across.all",
      phylo.metric = phylo_metric,
      sig.index = sig_index,
      bin.size.limit = bin_size_limit,
      nworker = nworker,
      memory.G = memory_G,
      rtree.save = FALSE,
      detail.save = FALSE,
      qp.save = FALSE,
      detail.null = FALSE,
      ignore.zero = TRUE,
      output.wd = s_out,
      unit.sum = rowSums(comm_s),
      correct.special = TRUE,
      ses.cut = 1.96,
      rc.cut = 0.95,
      conf.cut = 0.975
    )

    saveRDS(
      res_s,
      file.path(s_out, "icamp_res.rds")
    )

    proc_s <- find_icamp_process_table(res_s)$table

    bt_s <- run_icamp_boot_one_group(
      "Season",
      proc_s,
      meta_s,
      s_out
    )

    if (!is.null(bt_s)) {
      plot_icamp_boot_bar(
        bt_s,
        paste0("Season_", stype),
        s_out
      )
    }
  }

  write.csv(
    bind_rows(stage_pool_counts),
    file.path(
      sens_stage_dir,
      "stage_specific_regional_pool_ASV_and_coverage_summary.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

## 22. README and reproducibility records
```{r reproducibility-records}
readme_lines <- c(
  "iCAMP analysis of bacterial ASV communities across brewing cycles",
  "==============================================================",
  "",
  "OUTPUT POLICY",
  "Default outputs are restricted to primary results, compact QC summaries and reproducibility records; reconstructable intermediate tables are diagnostic-only.",
  "",
  "PRIMARY ASV INCLUSION RULE",
  "The primary iCAMP analysis does not apply an additional prevalence filter.",
  "All ASVs observed in at least one core sample and represented in the phylogenetic tree are retained.",
  "The primary regional pool is shared by BZ and EZ to preserve a common phylogenetic/binning framework.",
  "",
  "CORE SAMPLE POOL",
  "Only Cycle1/Cycle2 and SampleType BZ/EZ are included in the primary analysis.",
  "Boundary_Pre, Boundary_Post and Qu samples are excluded.",
  "Core metadata samples missing from the ASV table are never dropped silently: a compact QC summary is always written and missing samples trigger a warning plus a detail file.",
  "",
  "WHY THIS DIFFERS FROM SINGLE-ASV DIFFERENTIAL-ABUNDANCE FILTERING",
  "iCAMP first partitions taxa into phylogenetic bins and applies bin-level null models.",
  "Removing ASVs can alter bin membership, null-model space and abundance-weighted process estimates.",
  "Therefore, prevalence filtering is not imposed on the primary tree-matched ASV community.",
  "",
  "TREE MATCHING",
  "Only ASVs present in both the core ASV matrix and the phylogenetic tree can enter iCAMP.",
  "Tree coverage is reported by ASV count and, more importantly, by abundance coverage overall, by SampleType and per sample.",
  "Interpretation is restricted to the phylogenetically represented community.",
  "",
  "TAXONOMY QC",
  "Taxonomy is optional and does not define iCAMP bins or process estimates.",
  "A compact taxonomy-matching summary is always written when taxonomy.tsv exists; low coverage triggers a warning and unmatched final ASVs are listed once.",
  "",
  "OPTIONAL SENSITIVITY ANALYSES",
  "Prevalence sensitivity: minPrev = 3 and 9 core samples.",
  "Bin-size sensitivity: bin.size.limit = 12, 24 and 48.",
  "Independent SampleType regional pools: BZ and EZ are rerun separately from the unfiltered core ASV matrix.",
  "",
  "DESIGN INTERPRETATION",
  "Year is used for traceability/QC and is not a complete annual replicate.",
  "BrewingCycle is the complete brewing-cycle replicate.",
  "For BZ/EZ, BrewingCycle labels are strictly checked against the fixed Year × Season design mapping before analysis.",
  "Season denotes the brewing season/production period.",
  "Park and WorkshopAge are one-to-one and are interpreted as a composite production background.",
  "",
  "PRIMARY GROUPINGS",
  "SampleType bootstrap for overall BZ/EZ profiles",
  "Season effects are handled by context-level summaries/inference rather than a second bootstrap grouping",
  "",
  "CONTEXT-LEVEL INFERENCE",
  "Context_SampleType = BrewingCycle × Season × Park × SampleType.",
  "Context-level Season tests use context summaries and control for nonconstant BrewingCycle and Park factors.",
  "Season bin summaries include all pairs within Season x SampleType, including cross-context pairs; context-level community summaries use within-context pairs only. These estimands are distinct.",
  "This script uses a BZ/EZ-only primary pool with no additional prevalence filter; verify agreement with the manuscript before release.",
  "",
  "PROCESS TERMINOLOGY",
  "DR_Others denotes drift and other weak/undominated processes; it is not interpreted as pure ecological drift.",
  "Context-level, cross-cycle and cross-park summaries use the five mutually exclusive processes only; Stochasticity is an aggregate and is not treated as a sixth process.",
  "",
  "BIN-LEVEL ANALYSIS",
  "icamp.bins() is always run for the primary analysis.",
  "Wtuvk, Ptk, BPtk, BRPtk and Binwt are saved every run; Bin.TopClass is saved when available.",
  "Primary icamp.bins uses between.group = FALSE; within-group bin summaries are retained without redundant pairwise group comparisons.",
  "The pd_big cache is rebuilt for the primary analysis and for every enabled sensitivity run to avoid reusing phylogenetic distances from a different tree/ASV pool.",
  "Custom ASV-to-bin and representative-tree outputs use bin IDs formatted as bin1, bin2, ... to match BPtk/Ptk/Binwt columns.",
  "The native iCAMP label DR in bin-level outputs corresponds to DR_Others in this script.",
  "",
  "PRIORITY OUTPUTS",
  "00_analysis_parameter_manifest.csv",
  "QC_core_sample_matching_summary.csv",
  "QC_tree_matching_coverage_summary.csv",
  "QC_taxonomy_matching_summary.csv (when taxonomy.tsv exists)",
  "QC_tree_matching_coverage_by_SampleType.csv",
  "icamp_boot_summary_SampleType.csv",
  "context_level_assembly_processes.csv",
  "context_level_Season_SampleType_summary.csv",
  "context_level_Season_effect_permutation_tests.csv",
  "cross_cycle_reproducibility_by_Season_SampleType.csv",
  "cross_park_context_process_consistency.csv",
  "Plot_iCAMP_bar_SampleType.pdf",
  "Plot_context_level_Season_by_SampleType.pdf",
  "iCAMP_bin_Wtuvk.csv",
  "iCAMP_bin_Ptk.csv",
  "iCAMP_bin_BPtk.csv",

  "Plot_Representative_bin_tree.pdf",

writeLines(

package_versions <- data.frame(

  Version = vapply(
    key_packages,
    function(pkg) {
      if (requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {

write_diagnostic_csv(
```
